notes.title: Version 1.4.56 Update
notes.content:
A small update to address a few issues that have built up since the last release.

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential soft lock in one of the early-game NPC conversations
[*] Fixed the rest of the achievements (it should give you them on your next load if you're supposed to already have them)
[*] Significantly reduced and refined the 'edge-of-ledge' movement code. It's much nicer now. 
[*] Added the ability to skip most cut-scenes for those people that like that sort of thing ('Return' on keyboard, 'B' on gamepad)
[/list]

As I said in previous update, I'm not putting anywhere near as many hours into Moonstone Equation as I used to (so I can work on new stuff) so it will probably be a long time before there's another update (unless some new terrible bug is discovered).

As ever, I'll always be checking the community hub, social media and all my emails so you can still make sure I hear you if you have any ideas or issues. I'm also not totally ruling out more content in the future (It's just very unlikely)


[b]Thank you again for all your amazing support.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Anniversary Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/3623e4a6c42567f629b0162ea9df9c0573f4d420.png[/img]

How time flies. 

It's been a year since the original release of The Moonstone Equation and what better way to celebrate than by adding a little bit more content, fixing a few last bugs and having a bit of a sale. 

Once again, It's thanks to all of you for playing, enjoying and giving me great feedback over the last year. Everything from the bug reports and comments to the screenshots and amazing guide have all given me what I need to keep going. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/73a0e7c7964aa08b0741e946fadb03dfd51485ef.gif[/img]

This is probably one of the last updates to The Moonstone Equation. 
Unless someone finds some critical bug then the [b]'Anniversary Edition'[/b] will act as a fitting end its long development (over 10 years now).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/f002295096adb5a5a948d081606e9e1af7dac43a.gif[/img]

The end? 

It's impossible to say that a game is never going to get an update or re-release but for now, yes this is probably the end. As I said when I released the complete edition, there's only one of me and I need to spend less time making the Moonstone Equation if I want to spend any time making anything new. 

As ever, I'll always be checking the community hub, social media and all my emails so you can still make sure I hear you if you have any ideas or issues. I'm also not totally ruling out more content in the future (It's just very unlikely)


[b]Thank you again for all your amazing support.[/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Complete Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/b123c09d307ae079f0841bab54c6103a089901e0.png[/img]

It's been nearly four months since the first release of The Moonstone Equation and since then development has not really stopped (or slowed down). 

I've released a dozen updates packed full of fixes and new features that have transformed the game as it was at release into something even better.

I have you the community to thank for much of that progress. You've provided great feedback (and found some great bugs) and your enthusiasm has ensured I've had the drive to work every day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/73a0e7c7964aa08b0741e946fadb03dfd51485ef.gif[/img]

Today I'm marking a change in pace for any future developments and updates for the Moonstone Equation with the release of the [b]'Complete Edition'[/b] 

This update has the usual collection of small bug fixes and tweaks but more significantly it also includes[b] 25 Steam Achievements! [/b] for you to find and unlock. From now on any updates will only contain minor additions and occasional bug fixes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/414caf1cdccd01e3aa0ff634f3e27f3ed05e7296.gif[/img]

Is this the end? 

Not really, it's just a change of pace. There's only one of me and I need to spend less time making the Moonstone Equation if I want to spend any time making anything new. 

I'll always be checking the community hub, social media all my emails so you can still make sure I hear you if you have any ideas or issues. I'm also not totally ruling out more content in the future. 


[b]Thank you again for all your amazing support.[/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Big Update - Version 1.3.53
notes.content:
It's been a few months since the last update. With the worst of the bugs squashed in the early updates I moved onto some more significant content changes. These have obviously taken longer to implement but hopefully you'll find the wait has been worth it. 

There are fixes, changes and additions across the whole game. It will all integrate with your existing saves but if you want the full experience then you might prefer to start a new game. The easy way to do this is through the 'factory reset' option in the PDA menu (esc) or the quicker and more direct way is to press 'n' twice on the very first loading screen (you'll see a little message if you've done it right).

Some of the changes will be obvious very quickly but others are in some very obscure places. Also, some of the new puzzle are intentional very hard (but fair).  

In general it seems that most of you have enjoyed searching around and piecing the parts of the plot jigsaw together at your own pace and in your own way. My intention was always to try and reward curiosity but there was a common thread of people feeling a little lost for what to do next. 

I've not added any additional hand-holding but I hope you'll find the plots and pieces that make up the fractured world-story a little easier to piece together and as such find it a little easier to choose what you might want to do next. There's still plenty of very obscure and hidden stuff for those of you that really want to get all the answers.

So, With all that out of the way it's on to the bullet points. in no particular order.

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] More dialogue for almost all the characters. Some characters now have more than twice as much to talk about over the whole game.
[*] More collectibles (and more plot because of them)
[*] More post end-game content.
[*] More puzzles. Not block pushing and not obvious to 90% of players but they probably represent a good few more hours of gameplay if you can find them. The early ones are easy enough but they get pretty hard.
[*] More hidden but direct clues and information about the lore and meaning of the Moonstone Equation.
[*] Subtle but important changes to the ledge balance points when idle. No more standing in mid-air. (also no more pushing blocks from mid-air, sorry) 
[*] Command history for terminals (just press 'up' and 'down' to step through previous commands.
[*] Improved terminal email client a little bit.
[*] Added the missing 'DigSite' terminal into the dig-site.
[*] Allowed executable to use extended 32Bit memory space (Upto 3GB) so out-of-memory crashes should not happen anymore.
[*] A few subtle level adjustments that you'd only notice if you know what to look for. 
[*] A few other small bug fixes.
[/list]

If you're interested, you can follow my development progress very directly by looking at my 
[b][url=https://trello.com/b/2gMFRRiP/moonstone-equation] Trello Board[/url][/b]

[b]Warning![/b] That's a direct look at my development tasks and my contain some spoilers. As much as possible I'll try not to give too much away but you have been warned.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Friday Update - Version 1.3.51
notes.content:
Another week and another Friday update. It's a pretty big one this week with lots of little fixes and a few much requested features. 

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Doors that's you've been through before will now tell you where they go 
[*] Special doors now indicate your progress in the special levels behind them.
[*] You can nolonger break your game by [spoiler] leaving the moon before picking up the sight stone[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a control issue while swimming and pressing jump at the bottom of pools
[*] Fixed lots of cases where chat dialogs didn't respond to input
[*] opening a computer terminal while far away from a chatty NPC now works as expected
[*] [spoiler] Hint dots under each level intro text are now correct in all cases [/spoiler]
[*] completed door puzzles now show the correct state when you view them.
[*] Fixed lots of level exploits. 

[/list]

If you're interested, you can follow my development progress very directly by looking at my 
[b][url=https://trello.com/b/2gMFRRiP/moonstone-equation] Trello Board[/url][/b]

[b]Warning![/b] That's a direct look at my development tasks and my contain some spoilers. As much as possible I'll try not to give too much away but you have been warned.

[/list]


Thank you everyone.

notes.title: Version 1.2.46 - Now Available
notes.content:
This is just a quick update that fixes and small but fairly serious issue in the unlocking of some areas of the game world. I know this might sound vague so if you're really interested you can read the spoilers below.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[spoiler]
If you'd used exactly the same number of trigger stones as you'd found then the interface door in The Lower Waterworks would disappear (or never show up), along with your trigger stone notes. This would obviously have stopped you completing the game if you'd already found and used all the trigger stones. 

This is all fixed now.
[/spoiler]

Thank you everyone

Andy      

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.2.45 - Now Available
notes.content:
Perhaps this version could be called 'the great escape' update as there are several significant fixes to levels (I had to add to the save file data just to fix some of these) so you shouldn't be getting stuck in odd places anymore.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added escape capability to [spoiler]MoonLab[/spoiler]
[*] Removed random water block in [spoiler]Lower Waterworks[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed incorrect block in [spoiler]Lower Waterworks[/spoiler]
[*] Removed [spoiler]data block[/spoiler] exploit in one of the levels
[*] Very significantly reduced the graphics memory footprint in all levels (should help stability)
[*] Added more memory allocations into pooling to reduce fragmentation issues (also to help stability)
[*] Electric doors now wait about 1 second before opening or closing just to make sure the signals have settled down. 
[/list]

Thank you so must to everyone that's sent me save files, crash dumps and links to images and streams of bugs. These have all been immensely helpful in tracking down some of these issues. 

It looks like I'm starting to settle into a pattern of end-of-week updates and patches. Unless there's a really critical problem then this feels like a good update rate. See you again next week.

Thank you everyone

         Andy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.1.44 - Now Available
notes.content:
This one's a pretty serious one so it get's a different version number change. That middle number only changes if I add or change things to the save format. In this case I fixed things.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Significant issue in the game saves is now fixed, if you've lost progress between past updates that should all be okay now.
[*] Journal entries (when to load the game) should be much more interesting (because they now work properly)
[*] Fixed an exploitable level. A few more to come.
[*] A few spelling issues fixed.
[*] D-Pad support everywhere.
[/list]

[h1]What Next[/h1]

Continuing with the work on achievements but also looking at some of the more subtle signs and feedback issues that a few people have pointed out. 

Don't forget, if you're still having any issues (or just want to talk about things) you can post them up here and/or email me directly at support@moonstoneequation.com


Thankyou everyone

Andy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.0.44 - Now Available
notes.content:
So, it looks like along with all the lovely fixes in the last patch I incuded a few extra problems. This patch aims to fix them and a few other things.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]

[list]
[*] Unlocked things from prior to 1.0.43 should be unlocked again. sorry to be vague but it's mostly late-game secret stuff.
[*] Setting the music to zero persists across levels
[*] Reduced the activation distance for doors (no more accidental room exiting)
[*] Fixed lots of general level issues. Including getting stuck in [spoiler] The Lower Waterworks[/spoiler]
[*] Lots of camera behaviour improvements in [spoiler] the mines[/spoiler]
[*] Stopped terminals starting up if you're having a conversation.
[/list]

[h1] What Next [/h1]

Some serious issues in the previous patch mostly forced me to change my priotities to get those things fixed. This patch has had a lot more testing (as I'm not submitting it at 11pm) so it shouldn't case as much trouble.

This all means I plan to focus on some fun stuff and act on all the useful feedback I've been recieving from lots of different sources over the past few days. 

Obviously, if you're still having any issues (or just want to talk about things) you can post them up here and/or email me directly at support@moonstoneequation.com


Thankyou everyone

     Andy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.0.43 - Now Available
notes.content:
Thanks for all the great feedback you've given me over the past few days as well as the nice clear reports of the bugs and issues a few of you have had. I've put together a new version that resolves lots of these and I'm working to make more improvements and fixes in the coming days and weeks. 

[h1] Fixes [/h1]

[list]
[*] The whole game should be a lot more stable with much less occasional crashing
[*] The hang on exit should be gone now. 
[*] Adjusted (widened) the deadzones for gamepad thumb-stick. 
[*] Added d-pad support for movement and menues (still one secret thing needs the same treatment)
[*] Adjusted a level very slightly so you won't get stuck under some circumstances
[*] Adjusted the camera tracking in some parts of the world to give a better view platforms below you. More of this to come in future updates.
[*] Fixed an issue where one of the wall carving was partly missing.
[/list]

[h1] What Next? [/h1]

[list]
[*] It's recently been reported that some specific terminals can just sort of dissapear after a while. I'm looking into this.
[*] There's still some places where it would be nice to have a better view of platforms below your position. 
[*] Extra testing to make sure these fixes work on as many PC configurations as possible.
[*] Lots of general fun stuff and more little bugs.
[*] Start thinking about some fun steam achievements. Feel free to suggest things
[/list]


Thankyou everyone,


Andy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]

notes.title: Now Available - Version 1.0.41
notes.content:
It seems that being a one-man team releasing a PC game has it's risks. 
I'm very glad that most people have been able to enjoy The Moonstone Equation and I'm very grateful for all the positive feedback it's been receiving.

However, I'm also very aware that a few of you have not been able to play or have had some other issues. So, I've put together a quick patch to hopefully resolve one of the main issues for most (not getting into game) and I'll be spending the next few days hunting down the other issues.

For now I've released version 1.0.41 (visible on the screen when the game is loading). If you still have any issues, or find any new ones please let me know: [b]support@moonstoneequation.com[/b]

[h1] 1.0.41 - Potential Fixes [/h1]

A few people have been experiencing an issue on start-up that results in the message

[i]Graphics Error , no matching display modes.[/i] 

This patch should fix this issue for most people. I'm working on a even more robust 'bomb-proof' fix but it'll take a little longer and I thought I'd get this out to you all while I worked. 


[h1] 1.0.41 - Known Issues [/h1]

There still seems to be the potential for an occasional crash either during play (after going through a door) or on exit (including 'factory reset'). Your game progress is regularly saved so you shouldn't loose anything if this happens.

I'm looking into this but would very much value your help: 
If the Moonstone Equation crashes, it should create a 'dump' file (file extension dmp) in the install directory of the game. 

If you have one of these could you please send it to me at  [b]support@moonstoneequation.com[/b]

It'll help me identify the problem and speed up the process of creating a robust fix.

Thankyou everyone,



            Andy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27754766/ed54c581152033678526dc8e6aea7d6e3aabcbe7.png[/img]
